card.title: The tiny animal that went to space

body.claim: Tardigrades have survived exposure to outer space.
body.why: In 2007, dehydrated tardigrades were taken on the FOTON-M3 mission and exposed to vacuum, and to solar ultraviolet, for 10 days. Tardigrades are usually about 0.5 mm long when fully grown.

probes.question: True or false: tardigrades have survived exposure to outer space.
About how long is a fully grown tardigrade, usually?

image_brief.show: A microscope image of a tardigrade, or 'water bear'

claims.claim: Tardigrades have survived exposure to outer space (title, claim, probe 1)
claims.quote: Tardigrades have survived exposure to space.

claims.claim: In 2007 dehydrated tardigrades were taken on the FOTON-M3 mission
claims.quote: In 2007, samples of 30 tardigrades and 30 eggs, all dehydrated, were taken on the FOTON-M3 mission

claims.claim: They were exposed to vacuum and to solar ultraviolet
claims.quote: exposed tardigrades to vacuum, solar ultraviolet, or both
claims.note: Samples got vacuum alone, vacuum plus UVA/B, or vacuum plus full solar UV; the card's wording is a fair summary.

claims.quote: or to both vacuum and the full range of solar ultraviolet, for 10 days

claims.claim: Tardigrades are usually about 0.5 mm long when fully grown (probe 2 answer)
claims.quote: Tardigrades are usually about 0.5 mm (0.02 in) long when fully grown.
